en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...do robots have fantasies...?

Um, Shuichi... I have a favor I'd like to ask
of you.

It's embarrassing, but...you're the only one
I can turn to...
Ah, well...what kind of favor?
Well...

Will you...form a romantic pair bond with
me!?
A romantic pair bond!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I expected that some people would have
this kind of fantasy, but not Keebo...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...something's not quite right.

<CLT=cltMIND>He didn't ask for a confession or a
date, but a "pair bond"... Strange.

As you can see, I am a robot.
And I am not ashamed of that, but...

I have yet to experience the feeling of love.
Even human children have felt love before.

Ah, are you saying... You want to
experience that emotion with me?

Humans often say that love is the most
precious, wonderful feeling in the world.

I, too, wish to experience what love is.
Will you please help me?

Ah, so... Would you like me to
act like your lover, Keebo?

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose...
I could do that...

Of course, if we're going to do this, I will
need you to take it seriously.
Huh?

Why are you surprised? Simply going through
the motions would be dishonest.

We must love each other unconditionally...
We must understand each other completely...

We must go on dates, grow even closer... And
then, we must commit our lives to each other!
Now hold on a minute!
Oh? Did I speak out of turn?

No, it's not that, it's just...don't you
think that's a bit long term for a favor?
But...that's not wrong of me, is it?

Or do you believe there is an easier way to
feel love for another?

Ah, no, that's not what
I'm trying to say...

Then please take me, in sickness and in health,
so that I may truly know what love is!

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, he's going too fast!
I have to get him to ease up a little...

But, Keebo...do you really like me that much?
I don't want a relationship based on lies...
O-Oh... Well, now I feel rather...awkward...

I didn't want to hear you say that...I don't
actually love you.
Keebo...

I apologize if I gave the impression that I
wanted a dishonest relationship...

I just thought that you were the only person
I could ask for this sort of favor.

I couldn't have asked this of anyone else.
I just...want you to know that.

Is that true, Keebo? I am so sorry...
I should never have doubted your feelings.

No, I don't blame you for feeling skeptical.
My approach was wholly lacking in tact.

It's obvious now that my overzealousness for
romance has earned your scorn...

H-Hey now...
I didn't say "no."
...Really?

I don't have a plan for the future...
but I know I want to help you, Keebo.
I think...I might already be in love with you.
Huh? Wh-What?

I think...my feelings for you are increasing
at an exponential rate!

Please, say more kind words to me!
I don't want these feelings to go away!

Ah! Neither do I, it's just...I get
embarrassed, saying things like that...
Then...may I...
h-hold your hand?
My hand...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I may not have much experience with love,
but I know I can't turn him down...
Well...if it's just that...okay.

<CLT=cltMIND>I reached out my hand, and Keebo reached
out his. The robotic hand didn't quiver.
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Ah...Keebo?
This is a handshake...

Huh!? Oh...that's right. Lovers hold hands
in a different fashion!

But...I'm quite nervous. Would it be alright
if we stayed like this a bit longer...?
My heart...is at peace right now.
Yes. Of course we can.

<CLT=cltMIND>His hand that I shook should've felt cold.
But somehow...it felt so, so warm.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
